verdict.rationale: The evidence lists 'Copilot Chat in Outlook and Teams' and says users can interact with Copilot using their work data via Microsoft Graph, so AI over the user's own data is surfaced inside Teams. The documentation is a thin overview on the Microsoft 365 Copilot page and does not describe the insights or suggestions Teams itself generates; agent-building, suggested-actions and prompt-starter docs are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: Teams-specific docs on AI-generated insights and suggestions (e.g., summaries or recommendations from chats and meetings), detail on what data feeds the insights, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Copilot Chat in Outlook and Teams
Securely interact with Copilot using web data and work data (Microsoft Graph and Work IQ)
